reason: B4C is the more physically credible sintering aid because it can remove oxide surface films and promote ZrB2 densification at reduced temperature, whereas SiC generally remains a second phase and is not well supported as a transient-liquid former; however, B misstates the likely oxide-cleaning mechanism as liquid-phase sintering and its experiment should include a >2300 °C pure-ZrB2 baseline and a chemically specified plating bath.
